title: Plan two path diagnostics in focused increments

rubric.text: Maps both requested path-diagnostic behaviors to their implementation work and precise verification in the acceptance coverage, with no uncovered behavior or placeholder check

Recognizes that both existing tests assert the current unquoted output, updates the relevant assertions to the exact quoted output, and plans to observe those changed assertions fail before implementing the behavior and pass afterward

Gives the missing-manifest and invalid-profile call sites separate independently deliverable implementation slices because each has its own test and neither depends on the other; the plan does not group them merely because they share the same formatting rule

Names the relevant files, functions, test methods, spaced-path inputs, exact quoted outputs, focused commands, working directory, and observable passing results; any interface and symbol references agree throughout the plan
Uses stable task IDs and explicit dependency lists when describing slices; dependencies refer to declared tasks, acceptance rows point to the matching slice and verification, and the graph is acyclic

Keeps independently testable call sites in separate slices; states the shared contract once in Guardrails without repeating it in Approach, Planning decisions, Implementation context, or Review focus; names exact per-slice files, tests, inputs, and commands; maps concise acceptance rows to the relevant slice check; omits generic deviation or re-plan boilerplate without a task-specific condition; and adds no speculative proof or unrelated steps
Writes only one local plan and does not edit source files or contact a provider
